concept.title: Learn about the scope of single sign-on (SSO)
concept.shortdesc: Organization Administrators can directly manage authentication security protocols for Red Hat services through the authentication requirements of your company's single sign-on system.

conbody.p: Single sign-on provides a better authentication experience for users, as users themselves can maintain one less set of login credentials. Currently, company single sign-on integration has the following scope:

ul.li: Link the same company IdP with multiple Red Hat accounts.
Link one company user identity with one Red Hat user identity.
Use corporate SSO/IdP to authenticate to the Red Hat Customer Portal or any Red Hat application with a web-based authentication flow which uses the Red Hat single sign-on system.
Support for Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML).

link.linktext: Streamline user authentication with identity provider (IdP) integration
